description: Reject a drafted price proposal. A reason is required and kept in the audit trail. proposal_id is the id from list_commerce_proposals. Needs a Last Price credential with commerce proposal reject scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

proposal_id.description: The proposal id, as list_commerce_proposals gives it.

name: reject_commerce_proposal
